unit.id: The First Computer#1

segment.source: The First Computer
segment.target: Първият компютър

unit.id: Code named "Project PX" and funded by the United States Army, the first general-purpose computer was the Electronic Numerical Integrator And Computer (ENIAC). It was developed at the University of Pennsylvania's Moore School of Electrical Engineering.#1

segment.source: Code named "Project PX" and funded by the United States Army, the first general-purpose computer was the Electronic Numerical Integrator And Computer (ENIAC). It was developed at the University of Pennsylvania's Moore School of Electrical Engineering.
segment.target: Първият компютър с общо предназначение, с кодово име „Project PX“, е финансиран от армията на САЩ и се нарича електронен цифров интегратор и калкулатор (ENIAC). Разработен е в инженерното училище „Мур“ към Университета на Пенсилвания.

unit.id: ... And The Women Who Made It Work#1

segment.source: ... And The Women Who Made It Work
segment.target: … И жените, които го накараха да работи

unit.id: The ENIAC programmers included a number of women: Jean Bartik, Marlyn Wescoff Meltzer, Ruth Lichterman Teitelbaum, Kay McNulty Mauchly Antonelli, Frances Spence, and Frances Elizabeth "Betty" Holberton. Despite their groundbreaking work, the Army never released the names of the women who worked on the ENIAC, and they were largely forgotten until Kathy Kleiman discovered their story in 1985.#1

segment.source: The ENIAC programmers included a number of women: Jean Bartik, Marlyn Wescoff Meltzer, Ruth Lichterman Teitelbaum, Kay McNulty Mauchly Antonelli, Frances Spence, and Frances Elizabeth "Betty" Holberton. Despite their groundbreaking work, the Army never released the names of the women who worked on the ENIAC, and they were largely forgotten until Kathy Kleiman discovered their story in 1985.
segment.target: Сред програмистите на ENIAC има няколко жени: Джийн Бартик, Марлин Уескоф Мелцър, Рут Лихтерман Тейтълбаум, Кей Макнълти Мокли Антонели, Франсис Спенс и Франсис Елизабет „Бети“ Холбъртън. Въпреки новаторската им работа армията не публикува имената им и те са почти забравени, докато Кати Клайман не открива историята им през 1985 г.

unit.id: Rózsa Péter: The Poet of Recursion#1

segment.source: Rózsa Péter: The Poet of Recursion
segment.target: Роза Петер: поетесата на рекурсията

unit.id: Hungarian-born Rózsa Péter studied number theory and poetry before becoming interested in the idea that would become recursion theory. She published her paper "Recursive Functions" in 1951, but it wasn't until the mid-50's that she began to apply her work to the realm of computers.#1

segment.source: Hungarian-born Rózsa Péter studied number theory and poetry before becoming interested in the idea that would become recursion theory. She published her paper "Recursive Functions" in 1951, but it wasn't until the mid-50's that she began to apply her work to the realm of computers.
segment.target: Родената в Унгария Роза Петер изучава теория на числата и поезия, преди да се заинтересува от идеята, станала теория на рекурсията. Публикува статията си „Рекурсивни функции“ през 1951 г., но започва да прилага работата си към компютрите едва в средата на 50-те.

unit.id: Grace Hopper Invents The Compiler#1

segment.source: Grace Hopper Invents The Compiler
segment.target: Грейс Хопър изобретява компилатора

unit.id: In her career with the Navy, Rear Admiral Grace Hopper worked on the first commercial computer (UNIVAC) and laid the groundwork for the programming language COBOL. But her most notable invention was the compiler, which can transform a source language into binary code. (In other words, it can translate the code you and I write into 0s and 1s.) She developed it in 1952, but she said "Nobody would touch it. They told me computers could only do arithmetic."#1

segment.source: In her career with the Navy, Rear Admiral Grace Hopper worked on the first commercial computer (UNIVAC) and laid the groundwork for the programming language COBOL. But her most notable invention was the compiler, which can transform a source language into binary code. (In other words, it can translate the code you and I write into 0s and 1s.) She developed it in 1952, but she said "Nobody would touch it. They told me computers could only do arithmetic."
segment.target: Във флота контраадмирал Грейс Хопър работи по първия търговски компютър (UNIVAC) и полага основите на COBOL. Най-значимото ѝ изобретение е компилаторът, който преобразува програмен език в двоичен код — нулите и единиците на машината. Разработва го през 1952 г., но казва: „Никой не искаше да го докосне. Казваха ми, че компютрите могат само да смятат.“

unit.id: Contributions To Space Exploration#1

segment.source: Contributions To Space Exploration
segment.target: Принос към изследването на космоса

unit.id: One of the first African-American women to earn a Ph.D in mathematics, Evelyn Boyd Granville focused on aeronautics and space during her career. In 1956, she worked with NASA and IBM on Project Mercury, the first manned space flight. She worked with NASA again a few years later on the Apollo Project.#1

segment.source: One of the first African-American women to earn a Ph.D in mathematics, Evelyn Boyd Granville focused on aeronautics and space during her career. In 1956, she worked with NASA and IBM on Project Mercury, the first manned space flight. She worked with NASA again a few years later on the Apollo Project.
segment.target: Евелин Бойд Гранвил е сред първите афроамериканки с докторска степен по математика. Тя се занимава с авиация и космос, а през 1956 г. работи с NASA и IBM по „Мъркюри“ — първия пилотиран космически полет. По-късно отново работи с NASA по „Аполо“.

unit.id: The First PHD in Computer Science#1

segment.source: The First PHD in Computer Science
segment.target: Първата докторска степен по компютърни науки

unit.id: One of the first women (if not the first woman) to earn a Ph.D in computer science, Sister Mary Kenneth Keller also contributed to the development of the BASIC language during her time at Dartmouth College. She then founded the computer science department at Clarke College and directed it for the next 20 years.#1

segment.source: One of the first women (if not the first woman) to earn a Ph.D in computer science, Sister Mary Kenneth Keller also contributed to the development of the BASIC language during her time at Dartmouth College. She then founded the computer science department at Clarke College and directed it for the next 20 years.
segment.target: Сестра Мери Кенет Келър е сред първите жени, а може би и първата, получили докторска степен по компютърни науки. В колежа Дартмут тя допринася и за развитието на BASIC. След това основава катедрата по компютърни науки в колежа Кларк и я ръководи 20 години.

unit.id: Karen Spärck Jones Makes Search Possible#1

segment.source: Karen Spärck Jones Makes Search Possible
segment.target: Карън Сперк Джоунс прави търсенето възможно

unit.id: A professor at Cambridge Computer Laboratory, Spärck Jones was interested in natural language processing and information retrieval. In 1972, she introduced the concept of inverse document frequency, which most search engines still rely on.#1

segment.source: A professor at Cambridge Computer Laboratory, Spärck Jones was interested in natural language processing and information retrieval. In 1972, she introduced the concept of inverse document frequency, which most search engines still rely on.
segment.target: Като преподавател в компютърната лаборатория на Кеймбридж, Сперк Джоунс се интересува от обработка на естествен език и извличане на информация. През 1972 г. въвежда понятието обратна честота на документа, което и днес използват повечето търсачки.

segment.source: "The Mother of the Internet"
segment.target: „Майката на интернет“

unit.id: Often called "the Mother of the Internet," Radia Perlman's work on spanning tree protocol enabled the development of modern networking. She holds more than 100 patents, which is what mothers do best.#1

segment.source: Often called "the Mother of the Internet," Radia Perlman's work on spanning tree protocol enabled the development of modern networking. She holds more than 100 patents, which is what mothers do best.
segment.target: Радия Пърлман често е наричана „майката на интернет“. Работата ѝ по протокола spanning tree позволява развитието на съвременните мрежи. Тя има над 100 патента — нещо, в което майките са най-добри.

unit.id: Ancient Olympic Games#1

segment.source: Ancient Olympic Games
segment.target: Древните Олимпийски игри

unit.id: The first written evidence of the official Games dates from 776 BC, when the Greeks began measuring time in Olympiads, or the duration between each edition of the Olympic Games. The first Olympic Games were held every four years in honour of the god Zeus. From then on, a number of artistic activities such as music, singing, poetry and theatre were organised at the Pythian or Delphic Games (a separate event to the Games held in Olympia), linking culture and sport right from the beginning of the Games.#1

segment.source: The first written evidence of the official Games dates from 776 BC, when the Greeks began measuring time in Olympiads, or the duration between each edition of the Olympic Games. The first Olympic Games were held every four years in honour of the god Zeus. From then on, a number of artistic activities such as music, singing, poetry and theatre were organised at the Pythian or Delphic Games (a separate event to the Games held in Olympia), linking culture and sport right from the beginning of the Games.
segment.target: Първите писмени сведения за официалните игри са от 776 г. пр.н.е., когато гърците започват да измерват времето в олимпиади — периода между отделните издания. Игрите се провеждат на всеки четири години в чест на Зевс. По-късно в Питийските или Делфийските игри (отделно събитие от игрите в Олимпия) се организират музика, песни, поезия и театър, свързвайки културата и спорта още от самото начало.

unit.id: Ban of Olympic Games#1

segment.source: Ban of Olympic Games
segment.target: Забрана на Олимпийските игри

unit.id: In 393 AD, the Roman Emperor Theodosius I banned the Olympic Games for religious reasons, claiming that they encouraged paganism. They were not revived until the modern era.#1

segment.source: In 393 AD, the Roman Emperor Theodosius I banned the Olympic Games for religious reasons, claiming that they encouraged paganism. They were not revived until the modern era.
segment.target: През 393 г. сл.н.е. римският император Теодосий I забранява игрите по религиозни причини, като твърди, че насърчават езичеството. Те са възстановени едва в модерната епоха.

unit.id: Olympic Games Revived in Paris#1

segment.source: Olympic Games Revived in Paris
segment.target: Олимпийските игри се завръщат в Париж

unit.id: A number of initiatives to re-establish an international sporting event were attempted at the end of the 19th century, but failed due to the lack of coordination among the worldwide sporting movement - until one man decided to bring the main stakeholders together in Paris.#1

segment.source: A number of initiatives to re-establish an international sporting event were attempted at the end of the 19th century, but failed due to the lack of coordination among the worldwide sporting movement - until one man decided to bring the main stakeholders together in Paris.
segment.target: В края на XIX век има няколко опита за възстановяване на международно спортно събитие, но липсата на координация между световните спортни организации осуетява плановете — докато един човек не решава да събере основните участници в Париж.

unit.id: The Olympic Games were therefore revived at the first Olympic Congress, organised by Baron Pierre de Coubertin and held at the Grand Amphitheatre at the Sorbonne University from 16 to 23 June 1894. Two thousand people attended, including 58 French delegates representing 24 sports organisations and clubs, and 20 delegates from Belgium, Great Britain, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Russia, Spain, Sweden and the United States representing 13 foreign sports federations.#1

segment.source: The Olympic Games were therefore revived at the first Olympic Congress, organised by Baron Pierre de Coubertin and held at the Grand Amphitheatre at the Sorbonne University from 16 to 23 June 1894. Two thousand people attended, including 58 French delegates representing 24 sports organisations and clubs, and 20 delegates from Belgium, Great Britain, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Russia, Spain, Sweden and the United States representing 13 foreign sports federations.
segment.target: Така игрите са възстановени на първия Олимпийски конгрес, организиран от барон Пиер дьо Кубертен в големия амфитеатър на Сорбоната от 16 до 23 юни 1894 г. Присъстват 2000 души: 58 френски делегати от 24 спортни организации и клуба и 20 делегати от Белгия, Великобритания, Гърция, Ирландия, Италия, Русия, Испания, Швеция и САЩ, представляващи 13 чуждестранни федерации.

unit.id: First Modern Olympic Games#1

segment.source: First Modern Olympic Games
segment.target: Първите модерни Олимпийски игри

unit.id: The first Olympic Games of the modern era took place in Athens, in the country where the original Games took place in Antiquity, in April 1896.#1

segment.source: The first Olympic Games of the modern era took place in Athens, in the country where the original Games took place in Antiquity, in April 1896.

unit.id: First Olympic Games Open to Athletes with Disabilities#1

segment.source: First Olympic Games Open to Athletes with Disabilities
segment.target: Първите Олимпийски игри за спортисти с увреждания

unit.id: The 1904 Olympic Games in St. Louis (Missouri) were the first to distribute gold, silver and bronze medals, and also included the first known disabled athlete to compete in the Olympic Games, George Eyser. He won six medals in gymnastics, three of which were gold.#1

segment.source: The 1904 Olympic Games in St. Louis (Missouri) were the first to distribute gold, silver and bronze medals, and also included the first known disabled athlete to compete in the Olympic Games, George Eyser. He won six medals in gymnastics, three of which were gold.
segment.target: Игрите през 1904 г. в Сейнт Луис (Мисури) са първите с раздавани златни, сребърни и бронзови медали. Там участва и първият известен спортист с увреждане — Джордж Айзър. Той печели шест медала в гимнастиката, три от които златни.

unit.id: First Olympic Games with Athletes from Five Continents#1

segment.source: First Olympic Games with Athletes from Five Continents
segment.target: Първите игри със спортисти от петте континента

unit.id: The Olympic Games in Stockholm in 1912 were the first to include competitors from all five continents represented by the Olympic rings. It was also the year that women made their debut in the swimming events.#1

segment.source: The Olympic Games in Stockholm in 1912 were the first to include competitors from all five continents represented by the Olympic rings. It was also the year that women made their debut in the swimming events.
segment.target: Олимпийските игри в Стокхолм през 1912 г. са първите с участници от всичките пет континента, представени от олимпийските кръгове. Тогава жените участват за първи път и в състезанията по плуване.
